He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton Bluejays]]. ==Early career== Krampelj was a member of youth categories at [[KK Grosuplje|Grosuplje]] and later [[KK Krka Novo Mesto|Krka]]. ==College career== In 2015, Krampelj announced his decision to attend the [[Creighton University]] in the United States and play for the [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton Bluejays]].{{cite web |title=Martin Krampelj: 2019 Draft Prospect |url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/martin-krampelj-2019-draft-prospect |website=nba.com |accessdate=12 July 2019}} Krampelj averaged 11.9 points and 8.1 rebounds per game as a redshirt sophomore, hitting 67.1-percent of his field goals. He tore his [[Anterior cruciate ligament|ACL]] in a game against [[Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball|Seton Hall]] on 17 January 2018, and was forced to miss the rest of the season.{{cite news |title=Creighton's Martin Krampelj out for season after tearing ACL |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2018/01/18/creightons-martin-krampelj-out-for-season-after-tearing-acl/109578892/ |accessdate=19 November 2019 |work=[[USA Today]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=18 January 2018}} As a redshirt junior, Krampelj averaged 13.5 points and 6.9 rebounds per game, shooting 59.2 percent from the floor. He was named Honorable Mention All-[[Big East Conference|Big East]] and led the Bluejays to a 20–15 record, advancing to the quarterfinals of the [[National Invitation Tournament]]. After the season, he opted to forego his final season of eligibility and enter the NBA draft.{{cite news |title=Creighton's Krampelj Will Skip Senior Season |url=https://www.wowt.com/content/sports/Creightons-Krampelj-Will-Skip-Senior-Season-510574641.html |accessdate=19 November 2019 |work=WOWT |date=29 May 2019}} ==Professional career== ===Cedevita Olimpija (2019–2020)=== After going undrafted in the [[2019 NBA draft]], Krampelj was named a member of the [[Denver Nuggets]] for the [[2019 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|title=Denver Nuggets announce 2019 NBA Summer League roster|url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/denver-nuggets-announce-2019-nba-summer-league-roster|website=NBA.com|access-date=12 July 2019}} On 12 July 2019, Krampelj signed his first professional contract with [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]].{{cite web|title=Cedevita Olimpija tabs rookie Krampelj|url=https://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/9smxlhxrqmhhsvja|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190712114025/https://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/9smxlhxrqmhhsvja|url-status=dead|archive-date=12 July 2019|website=EurocupBasketball.com|access-date=12 July 2019}} ====Loan to MoraBanc Andorra (2019–2020)==== On 18 December 2019, [[BC Andorra|MoraBanc Andorra]] announced that they had added Krampelj to their roster on loan from [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]].{{cite web|title=Martin Krampelj fitxa per un mes|url=https://www.bca.ad/martin-krampelj-fitxa-per-un-mes|date=18 December 2019|website=ca.ad|access-date=18 December 2019|language=ES}} ===GTK Gliwice (2020)=== On 20 August 2020, Krampelj signed with [[GTK Gliwice]] of the [[Polish Basketball League|PLK]].{{cite news|title=Martin Krampelj inks with GTK Gliwice|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/martin-krampelj-inks-with-gtk-gliwice/|newspaper=Sportando|date=20 August 2020|access-date=20 August 2020|last1=Carchia |first1=Emiliano }} In seven games he averaged 10.0 points, 6.1 rebounds, 1.4 assists and 1.9 steals per game. Krampelj parted ways with the team on 9 October.{{cite web|title=Krampelj leaves GTK Gliwice|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Poland/news/647721/Krampelj-leaves-GTK-Gliwice|website=Eurobasket.com|date=9 October 2020|access-date=9 October 2020}} ===Sioux Falls Skyforce (2021–2022)=== In October 2021, Krampelj joined the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] from the available player pool.{{cite web|title=Skyforce Announces 2021-22 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/skyforce-announces-2021-22-training-camp-roster/n-5758534|website=Our Sports Central|date=26 October 2021|access-date=27 October 2021}} On 3 February 2022, Krampelj was removed from the team by the Skyforce.{{cite web|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=NBA.com|access-date=24 January 2022}} On 10 February 2022, Krampelj was reacquired and activated by Sioux Falls. He played 31 games and averaged 9.5 points, 5.4 rebounds and 1.1 assists in 19.5 minutes.{{cite web|first=Alejandro|last=Ramos|title=Apunta al viejo
